We found test_vlan_tc5_untagged_unicast failed on 202405 branch.
The cause looks to be https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/12204
The question had been asked in that PR: In line 334-335 dst_port = ports_for_test[-1] -> dst_port = [6], which makes the test failed.
